name: fno-lab-microstructure-daemon
description: Companion tick-level microstructure daemon for F&O Lab - connects to Kite Connect's WebSocket ticker (a persistent connection a WordPress AJAX request/response cycle cannot maintain) and computes Cumulative Delta, Volume Profile POC, Order Flow Imbalance, Footprint, Tick Speed, and an Iceberg-order heuristic from real ticks.

scripts.test: node daemon-logic.test.js && node test-daemon-wp-ingest-fidelity.js && node test-secret-never-logged.js && node test-ticker-reconnect.js && node test-config-validation.js
